text: After dressing in the hay, I washed my face in cold water at the windmill. Breakfast was ready when I entered the kitchen, and Yulka was baking griddle-cakes. The three older boys set off for the fields early. Leo and Yulka were to drive to town to meet their father, who would return from Wilber on the noon train. ‘We’ll only have a lunch at noon,’ Ántonia said, and cook the geese for supper, when our papa will be here.
